_about: Places no runner should be routed through (decision 010). Hard rule: GraphHopper avoids them (priority 0 in the per-request custom model) and any route that still touches one is rejected. default=true zones apply to every request; the others only when a runner names them (RunConstraints.avoid_places, matched against name and aliases). Each zone carries its source.

properties.name: Times Square
properties.reason: Dense pedestrian crowds at all hours; no runner would choose it
